english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(1)(a) and (3) of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 3(1)(a) of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 provides that a minimum of TWO motor vehicles must be left to commit this offences
(ii) This offence is NOT directed at private individuals who are selling cars privately, so a person will not be convicted if he can prove he was NOT acting for the purposes of a business.
(iii) Section 6(9) of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 provides that the £100 fixed penalty ticket fee set by section 6(8) of the Act may by order of an authorised person of a local authority be substituted by a different amount.
